q: The power of a lens is inversely proportional to the _____ of the lens.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The power of a lens is inversely proportional to the focal length of the lens. Do not trade focal length for diameter or thickness.

q: The shorter the focal length the _____ is the power of the lens.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The shorter the focal length the greater is the power of the lens. Do not trade greater for smaller or zero.

q: Since the focal length of a convex lens is positive in sign it has a _____ power.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. Since the focal length of a convex lens is positive in sign it has a positive power. Negative or zero is not this quantity.

q: The focal length of a concave lens is negative so that it has a _____ power.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The focal length of a concave lens is negative so that it has a negative power. Positive or zero is not this quantity.

q: If a lens has a focal length of 1 metre, it has one unit power or one _____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If a lens has a focal length of 1 metre, it has one unit power or one dioptre. Do not trade dioptre for watt or joule.

q: The unit of power of a lens is denoted by the letter _____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The unit of power of a lens is denoted by the letter D. Do not trade D for P or W.

q: If the focal length $f$ is measured in metre, the power $P$ is equal to _____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the focal length f is measured in metre, the power P is equal to 1/f. 100/f or f/100 is a different relation from 1/f.

q: If the focal length $f$ is measured in centimetre, the power $P$ is equal to _____.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. If the focal length f is measured in centimetre, the power P is equal to 100/f. 1/f or f/100 is a different relation from 100/f.

q: The power of a lens is _____ proportional to the focal length of the lens.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. The power of a lens is inversely proportional to the focal length of the lens. Directly or linearly is not this quantity.

q: A lens with a shorter focal length has a _____ power.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. A lens with a shorter focal length has a greater power. Smaller or zero is not this quantity.

q: A lens with a positive focal length has a _____ power.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. A lens with a positive focal length has a positive power. Negative or zero is not this quantity.

q: A lens with a negative focal length has a _____ power.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. A lens with a negative focal length has a negative power. Do not trade negative for positive or zero.

q: One dioptre is the power of a lens with a focal length of _____ metre.
e: Work is F · s. Power is work per second, in watts. One dioptre is the power of a lens with a focal length of 1 metre. Do not trade 1 for 10 or 100.
